author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual

Combines the dHCP and BLS heatmap panels into the manuscript figures. Run `GLM_analyses_dHCP.qmd` and `GLM_analyses_essential.qmd` first.

- Input: `outputs/figures/p_heat_*.rds` (from `GLM_analyses_dHCP.qmd` and `GLM_analyses_essential.qmd`)
- Outputs (`outputs/figures`):
  - `Figure3_prematurity_heatmaps_final.tiff`: Supplementary Figure S4
  - `Figure5_earlyEnv_heatmaps_final.tiff`: Figure 4
  - `Figure7_CP_to_cognition_heatmaps_final.tiff`: Figure 5

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

# ROIs with FDR-significant group differences in CP, marked in the heatmaps
sig_roi_labels <- c(
  "Occipital Associative (R)", "Occipital Associative (L)", "Parietal Associative (L)",
  "Prefrontal Associative (L)", "Temporal Associative (L)", "Primary Motor (R)",
  "Primary Visual (R)", "Posterior Cingulate (R)"
)
sig_roi_labels_dHCP <- c(
  "Parietal Associative (R)", "Parietal Associative (L)", "Prefrontal Associative (R)",
  "Prefrontal Associative (L)", "Temporal Associative (R)", "Primary Auditory (L)",
  "Primary Motor (L)", "Primary Somatosensory (R)", "Primary Visual (R)",
  "Primary Visual (L)", "Posterior Cingulate (R)", "Posterior Cingulate (L)",
  "Hippocampus (R)"
)

strip_titles <- function(p) {
  p +
    labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 20, 5)
    )
}

make_two_panel <- function(p_left, p_right, filename, width = 12, height = 5) {
  
  p_left2  <- strip_titles(p_left)
  p_right2 <- strip_titles(p_right)
  
  fig <- p_left2 + p_right2 +
    plot_layout(
      ncol   = 2,
      guides = "collect",
      widths = c(1, 1)
    ) &
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  fig <- fig + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
  
  ggsave(
    here("outputs", "figures", filename),
    fig, width = width, height = height, dpi = 600
  )
  
  fig
}
```

## Supplementary Figure S4: perinatal variables

```{r}
p_heat_prem_BLS  <- readRDS(here("outputs", "figures", "p_heat_prem_BLS_noleg.rds"))
p_heat_prem_dHCP <- readRDS(here("outputs", "figures", "p_heat_dHCP.rds"))

fig3 <- make_two_panel(
  p_heat_prem_dHCP,
  p_heat_prem_BLS,
  filename = "Figure3_prematurity_heatmaps_final.tiff",
  width = 12,
  height = 5
)
```
